name: 原地小憩沉眠
usage: Personal non-commercial fan work only; see THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.

colourMatch.materialMask: Alpha >245, min(RGB)>95, max(RGB)-min(RGB)<65, B>=R-3, G<=R+3; decoded at 640x360.
colourMatch.curve: Per-channel piecewise linear interpolation through (0,0), (64,64), the three material quantiles, and (255,255), rounded to uint8. One fixed curve throughout the central action.
colourMatch.standingBlend: For the existing common-standing clips, identity LUT through frame 18, smoothstep over frames 18..54; reverse over frames N-55..N-19, then identity. Motion unchanged.
colourMatch.limitations: Matches exposure and pale white/lavender material, not character geometry or drawing style. Fixed curves do not remove generated lighting changes within an action.

processing: Central extraction [256,0,768,720] retaining the character coordinates; watermarked source export retained
Original dsh-pet HSV key and standing normalization; 720p encode from the normalized master before interpolation
Remove the source audio; suppress green spill in the white/lavender edges
Bidirectional optical-flow interpolation in premultiplied alpha, VP9 Alpha CRF 18

Separate the largest connected character component from detached sleep bubbles after HSV keying, including dark green shadows. Keep the character motion, fit the original detached bubbles within 160x70 source pixels above the head, and fade them from 7s to 8.5s. Do not draw new bubbles.
After the sleep bubbles have disappeared, estimate the final 0.5s return from frame 1140 to the first clean standing pose with eased bidirectional optical flow; preserve 1205 frames.
Remove only small detached bubble ghosts touching the top edge, bottom y at most 128, maximum alpha 160, area at most 4096; retain the largest character component

Match pale white/lavender material to HD idle with a fixed per-channel curve; preserve dark outlines and white highlight anchors, motion and alpha before VP9 Alpha CRF 18 re-encoding. Retain unchanged idle endpoints in existing shared-standing bridges. See colourMatch for the prior output, calibration and rebuild parameters.

quality.reviewNotes: Reviewed twelve full-action frames, existing shared-standing bridge samples and dark/light background composites. Exposure/pale lavender closer to HD idle, complete original action retained. Full decoded frame count, bounds, alpha comparison and green-spill checks passed. Drawing-style and shape differences remain.

originalRateMigration.selection: Every fifth decoded frame from the reviewed 120fps clip; preserves prior colour and local motion repairs; scale to 640x360.
originalRateMigration.note: Only the short common-standing bridges estimate poses; the centre action has no added frames.

processing: Restore original 640x360/24fps from the reviewed product input identified by inputCommit and inputSha256; retain raw source unchanged.
Keep existing colour correction and local motion/effect repairs; no fivefold motion interpolation.
Short eased bidirectional-flow bridges to the same idle standing frame; no extra static hold. Centre action unchanged before VP9 encoding.

quality.reviewNotes: Reviewed all sixteen boundary samples for all twenty shared-standing clips and checked retained centre action samples. Mild bridge softness and source drawing/style differences remain; arbitrary interruptions are not guaranteed seamless.
